# Certification content rules

These rules apply to AI-103 study content under `docs/`.

## Content focus

Write notes about the certification content and related Azure AI services. Do not create a standalone exam-objectives tracker unless the user asks for it.

## Module notes

Use `docs/modules/` for module-based study notes. Name module folders with a numeric prefix and readable slug, such as `01-plan-and-manage-an-azure-ai-solution/`.

## Azure service pages

Use `docs/azure-services/` for service reference pages. Each relevant Azure service should have a page or folder that explains:

- What the service is for
- When it appears in AI-103 content
- How it relates to other Azure services
- Important capabilities or limitations for certification study
- Official Microsoft documentation links

## Source boundaries

Do not copy Microsoft Learn passages. Write short original summaries. Link to Microsoft Learn or product documentation when a service fact, feature name, limit, or behavior matters.

## Study value

Prefer comparisons, decision notes, relationship diagrams, and concise reminders. Separate facts from personal study notes when a page contains both.
